narr: A lingering upper trough provided several days of thunderstorm activity across the region, with a dryline providing focus for development each day from Thursday May 4 through Monday May 8. Several of these storms were severe with damaging winds and large hail.
ev: The Department of Transportation reported water over sections of I-14 and S W S Young Drive.
lsr: DEPT OF TRANSPORTATION REPORTS WATER OVER SECTIONS OF I-14 AND S W YOUNG DR.
